parsed.refutation_attempt: No checks or guards exist to prevent integer overflow on the expression (max+1)*sizeof(int) or the subsequent multiplication. The function accepts an external array, so a caller can provide an element equal to INT_MAX, making max = INT_MAX. Adding 1 to this value overflows the signed int, resulting in undefined behavior that can lead to an undersized or excessively large allocation. No constant arguments, size checks, or dead code paths mitigate this. Therefore the vulnerability is real and can be triggered with an array containing INT_MAX.
